REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST

 

 

Country:  MOZAMBIQUE

Project:  Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project

Agreement: Preparation Advance No. -V522-MZ.

Assignment Title: Individual Consultancy Services to Provision Hydrologist Specialist Project Advisor for providing Project Advisory to undertaking the review of the hydrological studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

 

Reference: MZ-GMNK-442364-CS-INDV

 

 

 

The Government of Mozambique (GoM) hereinafter referred to as “the Borrower” have received Advance funds from International Development Association (IDA) towards the costs of the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project, Preparation Phase. The funds have been channeled through the Mphanda Nkuwa Hydroelectric Project Office (GMNK) as the Project Implementation Agency, and GMNK intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consulting Services for providing Project Advisory for undertaking the review of the hydrological studies of the planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.

 

 

The GMNK now invites eligible Individual Consultant (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Individual Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services. The shortlisting criteria are:

 

  1. qualification, experience and skills in providing Project advisory services for reviewing the hydrological studies of hydropower projects;
  2. a minimum of Post Graduate Degree in the relevant hydrological disciplines and must have at least 15 years of professional experience relevant to the assignment.
  3. description of similar assignments previously carried out - must have done at least two (2) similar assignments (hydrological of hydropower advisory services), and
  4. experience of working in Sub-Sahara Africa - at least one (1) of the assignments should be in Sub-Shara Africa - and other regions.

 

Evidence shall be attached as supporting documents for the Expression of Interest.

 

Objective

 

The Project is being prepared for seeking financial support of the World Bank (the “Bank”) and therefore must comply with the World Bank Safeguards Policies and Performance Standards (see the concept project information document stage at the WB website [1]).  Accordingly, the Mphanda Nkuwa Project needs to comply with the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) – Community Health and Safety (ESS4[2]). To this effect two panel of experts (PoEs) need to be formed: (i) Panel of Experts for Dam Safety (PoE-DS); and (ii) Panel of Experts for Environmental and Social Management (PoE-ESM).

Key Responsibilities/ Scope of Reviews

 

The hydrologist will:

 

  1. Review of the hydrological studies pertaining to the long-term inflow to the reservoirs, and spillway and diversion design floods with reference to international criteria. Assess the adequacy of spillway and diversion facilities, also considering increasing hydrological variability associated with global warming. Review of soil erosion data and estimate of sediment yield into the reservoirs, estimated reservoir sedimentation, and assessment of the long-term sustainable capacity that could be maintained by implementing appropriate management strategies. Review of layouts related to sediment management of the reservoirs including sediment flushing.
  2. Review of the design of spillway and tailrace facilities including flow conditions, energy dissipation and need for hydraulic modelling.
  3. Review of the designs of the diversion works, schedule and risk factors associated with diversion during construction and with the closure of diversion works at initial reservoir filling.

 

Expected Assignment Timeline

 

The assignment is for a period of six (6) years, covering project preparation, construction, and initial reservoir filling. The initial contract will be signed for a period of 2 years, with the potential for an extension to cover the full duration of preparation and implementation. The contract will be time-based, with an annual ceiling of 20 working days, subject to extension if needed.

 

Detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

 

The attention of interest is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank՚s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” - September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting for the World Bank`s policy on conflict of interest.

 

The Consultant will be selected in accordance with ICS – Individual Consultant Selection method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 08:30 to 16:30.

 

Expression of Interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by e-mail) by November 24, 2025, 14:00 local time, and be clearly marked “Individual Consultancy Services to Provision the Project Hydrologist Expert for Providing Project Advisory to Undertaking Hydrological Studies Review of the Planned Mphanda Nkuwa Hydropower Project.”

Rua dos Desportistas, No918, Edifício JAT V-3, 1o Andar, Maputo - Mozambique

Telefone: (+258)21 42 3873

procnotices.notice_text:
Solicitud de Ofertas

Documento de Licitación para la Contratación de perforación de 8 Pozos Geotérmicos

 

Contratante: LAGEO S.A. de C.V.

Proyecto: Proyecto Geotérmico Chinameca

Título del contrato: Servicios de perforación y de suministros de materiales, accesorios, tuberías y servicios complementarios para la perforación de 8 pozos geotérmicos en el campo geotérmico Chinameca.

País: República de El Salvador

N.° de préstamo/N.° de crédito/N.° de donación: P506109 / IBRD-9788

SDO n.°: SV-LAGEO-534011-CW-RFB

1.        La Comisión Ejecutiva Hidroeléctrica del Río Lempa (CEL) ha recibido financiamiento del Banco Mundial para cubrir el costo del Proyecto “Geothermal Energy for Sustainable and Inclusive Development Project” el cual se enfoca en el desarrollo del campo geotérmico de Chinameca y será ejecutado por la empresa subsidiaria de CEL, LAGEO S.A. de C.V. (en adelante LAGEO). Una parte de los fondos obtenidos del Banco Mundial será dedicada a los pagos en virtud de un contrato que tiene por objeto la perforación de pozos geotérmicos mediante provisión de Servicios Integrales de Perforación. El programa de perforación prevé la ejecución de 8 pozos direccionales terminados con diámetro de agujero de 12”1/4 y liner de 9”5/8, a profundidades entre 1800 y 2200 m (MD). Indicativamente, 5 de los pozos serán para fines de producción y 3 para fines de reinyección. Dichos pozos serán perforados en el campo geotérmico de Chinameca, departamento de San Miguel, a 130 Km al oeste de la Ciudad de San Salvador, cuyas características generales son descritas en la Sección VII del Documento de Licitación. El plazo estimado para la ejecución del contrato de Servicios Integrales de Perforación en objeto es de 31 meses.

2.      LAGEO invita a los Licitantes elegibles a presentar Ofertas en sobres cerrados para la prestación de servicios integrales de perforación, incluyendo al equipo de perforación y accesorios, servicios complementarios y todos los materiales necesarios para la perforación de los pozos.

3.        La Licitación se llevará a cabo mediante adquisiciones competitivas internacionales utilizando el método de Solicitud de Ofertas (SDO), conforme a lo previsto en las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión del Banco Mundial de septiembre 2023 (las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones”), y se encuentra abierta a todos los Licitantes elegibles, como se los define en las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones.

4.        La Licitación se llevará a cabo de conformidad con las “Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para los Prestatarios de Proyectos de Financiamiento de Inversiones” del Banco Mundial, y las Ofertas se evaluarán de conformidad con el procedimiento de evaluación establecido en los documentos de licitación. Se aplicará una ponderación del 50% para los Criterios con Puntaje (incluidos los factores técnicos y no relacionados con el precio) y una ponderación del 50% para el costo de la Oferta.

5.        Los Licitantes elegibles podrán obtener el documento de licitación en español previa presentación de una solicitud por escrito dirigida a la dirección que figura más abajo. El documento se enviará por correo electrónico en formato de archivo PDF.

6.   Las Ofertas deberán dirigirse a la dirección que se indica más abajo a más tardar el 16 de diciembre de 2026 hasta las 10:00 AM. No está permitida la presentación electrónica de las Ofertas. Las Ofertas recibidas fuera del plazo establecido serán rechazadas. Los sobres exteriores de la Oferta marcados como “OFERTA ORIGINAL” y los sobres interiores marcados como “PARTE TÉCNICA” se abrirán públicamente en presencia de los representantes designados por los Licitantes y cualquier persona que decida asistir, en la dirección que figura a continuación: Final 15 Avenida Sur y Bulevar Sur, Colonia Utila, 01501, Santa Tecla, La Libertad, El Salvador, el día 16 de diciembre de 2026 a las 11:00 AM. Todos los sobres marcados como “PARTE FINANCIERA” permanecerán sin abrir y se mantendrán bajo la custodia segura del Contratante hasta la segunda apertura pública de las Ofertas.

7.      Todas las Ofertas deben ir acompañadas de una “Garantía de Mantenimiento de la Oferta” por el monto de US$1,200,000.00.

8.      Se llama la atención sobre las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones que requieren que el Prestatario divulgue información sobre la propiedad efectiva del adjudicatario, como parte de la Notificación de Adjudicación de Contrato, utilizando el Formulario de Divulgación de la Propiedad Efectiva incluido en el documento de licitación.

9.       La dirección o las direcciones a las que se hace referencia más arriba son las siguientes:

Final 15 Avenida Sur y Bulevar Sur, Colonia Utila, 01501, Santa Tecla, La Libertad, El Salvador

Specific Procurement Notice

 

Request for Bids

Plant
Design, Supply and Installation

(Two-envelope Bidding Process, Without Prequalification)

 

 

Employer: LIBERIA ELECTRICITY CORPORATION (LEC)

Project: Regional Emergency Solar Power Intervention Project (RESPITE)

Contract title: Package 2: Hydro electro Mechanical (HEM)Works for the Mt. Coffee Hydropower Plant Extension

Country: Liberia

Project No.: P179267

Loan No. /Credit No. / Grant No.: IDA-72640

RFB No: LR-LEC-524740-CW-RFB

RE-Issued on: September  30, 2026

This SPN is re-issued to extend the submission deadline to December 14, 2026, following previous deadlines of June 17, 2026, and October 30, 2026.

  1. The Government of Liberia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Regional Emergency Solar Power Intervention Project (RESPITE) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Package 2: Hydro electromechanical (HEM)Works for the Mt. Coffee Hydropower Plant Extension. For this contract, the Borrower shall process the payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank’s Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing.
  2. The Liberia Electricity Corporation (LEC) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Package 2: HEM Works for the Mt. Coffee Hydropower Plant Extension in a period of 36 months. The Mt. Coffee Hydropower Plant (MCHPP) is located about 30km from Monrovia and has an installed capacity of 88MW, accounting for about 70% of Liberia’s generation profile.  The extension endeavor will increase MCHPP capacity by 42MW through the addition of 4x 10.5 MW Z-type Kaplan Vertical turbines, and extension of the existing powerhouse and associated civil works without altering the dam or intake structures, whilst ensuring continuous operation of the existing units. The MCHPP Extension will be executed via two contracts: (i) Package 1/ Civil works; and (ii) the current contract, Package 2/ Hydro-Electrical & Mechanical (HEM) works. Generally, the scope of the HEM works contract includes the design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of the turbine-generator sets; penstocks; intake gates, trashracks and stoplogs; draft-tube stoplogs; the SCADA system; main power and auxiliary transformers; extension of the powerhouse overhead crane; workshop and warehouse overhead crane; and the necessary balance-of-plant systems, among others, as further defined in this Request for Bids.
  3. Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, Seventh Edition – September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”) and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.
  4. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the bidding documents. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 80%, and for Bid cost: 20%.
  5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from Liberia Electricity Corporation and inspect the bidding document during office hours [09:00 am to 05:00 pm GMT] at the address given below.
  6. The bidding document in English may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of US$ 200.00. The method of payment will be by direct deposit into the following account -Ecobank Liberia Account No - 6101965512 - Account is in USD Swift Code: ECOCLRLM. The documents will be shared via email.
  7. Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before 10:00 am GMT, December  14, 2026. Electronic bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. The outer Bid envelopes marked “ORIGINAL BID”, and the inner envelopes marked “TECHNICAL PART” will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below. All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public Bid opening.
  8. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security of US$ 500,000.00.
  9. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.
  10. The address referred to above is:

Specific Procurement Notice

                                   Request for Bids - Non-Consulting Services

Employer: Government Technology Agency, Royal Government of Bhutan

Project: Accelerating Transport and Trade Connectivity in Eastern South Asia Phase 2 - Bhutan Project (P181278)

Contract title: Supply of International Internet Bandwidth for Government Networks under Indefeasible Rights of Use (IRU) approach

Country: Bhutan

Loan No. /Credit No. / Grant No.: IDA Credit No. 7756-BT and IDA Grant No. E431-BT

RFB No: GOVTECH/NCS-4/1

Issued on: October 14, 2026

  1. The Royal Government of Bhutan (the “Borrower”) has received financing from the World Bank for Accelerating Transport and Trade Connectivity in Eastern South Asia Phase 2 - Bhutan Project (P181278). The Government Technology Agency (the “Employer”), an implementing agency of the Borrower, intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Supply of International Internet Bandwidth for Government Networks under Indefeasible Rights of Use (IRU) approach.
  2. The Employer now invites sealed bids from eligible bidders to supply a 10-year indefeasible right of use (“IRU”) of IBW delivered at two specified interconnection points on the Bhutan-India border. The successful bidder will provide IBW to the Employer that affords access to the full global internet for all of the Employer’s outbound and inbound internet traffic during the 10-year IRU term.
  3. Bidding will be conducted through international competitive procurement using a Request for Bids (“RFB”) under the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, September 2023 and is open to eligible bidders as defined therein.
  4. The IRU purchase price will be fixed at USD 8 million. Bidders will compete on the quantity of IBW offered for a fixed price rather than the price charged for a fixed quantity. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the RFB, with 20% of bid score based on service quality offers and 80% based on IBW quantity offers.
  5. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid Security of USD 400,000 (USD Four Hundred Thousand) Only.
  6. Bids must be delivered to the address below by 1500 Hours (Bhutan Standard Time) (GMT+6 Hours) on or before December 11, 2026. Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. The outer Bid envelopes marked “ORIGINAL BID”, and the inner envelopes marked “TECHNICAL PART” will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on 1530 hours Bhutan Standard Time (GMT+6) on December 11, 2026. All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public Bid opening.
  7. Bidders intending to participate in this procurement shall be required to execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) prior to the issuance of the bidding documents. This requirement is necessary to safeguard sensitive technical information, including network architecture drawings, ensuring that such information is used solely for the purpose of preparing responsive bids and is not disclosed to unauthorized parties. Accordingly, the complete bidding documents shall be made available only to those bidders who have duly signed and submitted the NDA. The NDA template signed by the purchaser will be made available on https://tech.gov.bt/ for interested eligible bidders to submit it along with the written application as specified above. The NDA must be signed by an authorized representative and affix company’s official seal. A complete electronic set of the Bidding Documents, will be provided free of charge by email upon receipt of a written request and dully signed NDA.
  8. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from Ms. Tshering Lhamo, Procurement Assistant, GovTech Agency, at tsheringl@tech.gov.bt, with a copy to jamyangdema@tech.gov.bt, during office hours from 09:00 to 17:00 hours Bhutan Standard Time (GMT+6).
